_comment: Racing line optimizer. The line moves only sideways from its seed (track.json racingLineSeed) to minimise curvature, keeping the car (half its width + safetyMarginM) on asphalt plus kerbUse (0..1) of each kerb. shortestBlend > 0 pulls toward the shortest path on gentle sections. Re-run after physics changes (the speed profile depends on grip): npm run optimize-racing-line -- <id> --write, or the editor's Optimize line button. EXIT line (npm run optimize-exit-line -- <id> --write): before every corner followed by ai.json racecraft.exitStraightM of straight, from exitLeadM before the corner to exitShiftM after it, the line moves sideways by exitBumps smooth bumps chosen to minimise the time to the end of the straight; stored as track.json racingLineExit.
